purpose: Persistent browser projection of the current LBE architecture, ownership boundaries, evidence-gated implementation stages, acceptance strategy, and autonomous-agent continuation policy. Canonical repository/runtime evidence remains authoritative.
authority_rule: Live workspace/runtime evidence and the current LBE machine gate outrank this projection. A later stage unlocks only after the previous stage is documented PASS, committed, pushed, and remotely verified.
core_doctrine: Provider proposes. LBE governs. Approved adapters execute. Evidence proves what happened. Deterministic LBE validation owns completion truth.
evidence_order: canonical repository source and pushed commits

runtime_pipeline.meaning: Accept and validate the request without becoming execution authority.
Resolve and prove session, task, canonical workspace, project identity, mode, permission, runtime policy, provider/profile and persisted state.
Resolve Engineering, Audit, or Investigation behavior. Guidance constrains provider reasoning but does not grant authority.
Load only bounded project instructions, current evidence contract, and descriptions of registered governed capabilities with provenance.
Interpret the objective, form hypotheses, choose among exposed capabilities, and propose actions. The provider is replaceable and never becomes policy, execution, evidence, or completion authority.
Confirm that the requested capability exists and that arguments match the registered contract.
Return ALLOW, DENY, or a narrowly defined explicit authority decision requirement. Ordinary policy-covered work is automatic; there is no generic approval queue.
Execute only through the approved registered adapter. Filesystem, Git, terminal, network, MCP/plugin, hosted-service and later capabilities remain behind this boundary.
Record operation identity, result, hashes/diffs/output, receipts, evidence and correlations describing what actually happened.
Return governed receipts/evidence to the provider so reasoning may continue. Continuation owns no execution authority.
Evaluate current evidence, tests, repository state and completion contract. Provider prose cannot decide terminal success.
Persist session/task/checkpoint state, safe runtime events, receipts, evidence, recovery and terminal status.
Display persisted runtime truth, evidence, diffs, failures, blocked results and next action without becoming a second runtime.

ownership_split.provider_may: interpret, hypothesize, choose exposed tools, propose work
ownership_split.provider_must_not: claim that a proposed action executed
manufacture receipts, diffs, evidence or success

ownership_split.provider_may: state a belief that work is complete

runtime_loops.invariant: The truth loop outranks provider prose. A convincing provider response is never proof that an action executed or that the task is complete.

provides: active doctrine: ENGINEERING, AUDIT, or INVESTIGATION
mutation rule appropriate to the active mode
bounded root AGENTS.md project instructions when safely loadable
descriptions of currently exposed governed capabilities
agent_guidance.persistence_boundary: Only safe guidance metadata is persisted. Project instruction text and provider system prompt text remain provider-only and are not written into runtime events.
agent_guidance.authority_boundary: AgentGuidance informs reasoning only. It does not grant capabilities, alter policy, execute tools, create receipts, or decide completion.

autonomous_agent_policy.goal: Continue through the currently authorized objective without asking the user to approve each routine step.
continue_without_asking: read current owners, source, tests, gates and logs
run validation already required by the active gate
archive/install/test the exact canonical commit without altering protected dirty work
choose the next deterministic diagnostic step after a failure
rerun focused acceptance after a bounded proven repair inside authorized scope
record evidence required by the active gate
commit/push a bounded proven fix that is already inside the active machine-authorized scope, then continue validation
stop_only_for: a real authority or scope expansion
destructive/reset/delete work affecting protected or unrelated changes
authoritative evidence conflict that cannot be resolved read-only
a required mutation outside the active machine gate
missing evidence where continuation would require guessing
a failed validation that exposes a new architectural/product decision rather than a bounded defect
an intentional current product contract that conflicts with the acceptance contract
autonomous_agent_policy.failure_rule: A failed test is normally an investigation input, not a user-decision point. Diagnose and continue unless one of the stop conditions is reached.
autonomous_agent_policy.completion_rule: Do not mark a stage PASS until its required checkpoint is documented, committed, pushed and remotely verified.

implemented: Audit/Investigation mode guidance through existing TUI provider path
safe guidance metadata persistence without prompt/project-instruction persistence
remaining_evidence: installed TUI behavior from a clean canonical artifact
any still-required provider/profile/persistence evidence under the active gate
package/state secret scan and other PASS evidence explicitly required by the active runtime gate

dirty_b3_boundary.canonical_contract: The canonical 0098e9c TUI includes composer_hint, prefix grammar, /settings, /mcp, /skills, /attach and /mentions surfaces required by the existing acceptance tests.
dirty_b3_boundary.local_problem: Protected dirty B3 rewrites shadow that canonical interface and produced 123 passed / 2 failed in the dirty working-tree acceptance attempt.
dirty_b3_boundary.required_strategy: Do not mutate, reset or absorb protected B3 merely to make Stage 4 pass. Build/install/test an isolated clean projection of canonical origin/main. Only if the clean canonical artifact reproduces the failure is a new product defect proven.
preferred_flow: run installed TUI + governed tool + completion acceptance

deep_repository_audit.summary: The uploaded deep repository audit contains useful architecture, persistence, security, dependency, CI and technical-debt analysis, but its audited target/head was an older pravesh0306 fork and it explicitly classified that fork as stale relative to Letterblack0306 upstream. Its recommendations are research inputs only and must be re-verified against current canonical LBE main before use.
deep_repository_audit.rule: Never let historical audit findings override live machine governance, current source, current runtime evidence, or active acceptance results.
